recentItems.title: Lindsay Clancy to stand trial for first-degree murder
recentItems.description:
Lindsay Clancy's new trial is set for March 29, Judge William Sullivan said in court on Monday morning.

The Plymouth County District Attorney's Office did not say what charges Clancy would be retried for, but one of the prosecutors, Jennifer Sprague, said it would require a jury.
